claim: Saudi law bans employing domestic workers under 21
quote: It is prohibited to employ individuals under the age of twenty-one.

claim: The contract's Arabic text is official and must be translated into a language the worker understands
quote: The Arabic text shall be the official reference in the domestic work contract, and it shall be translated into the official language understood by the domestic worker in their country.

claim: Probation up to 90 days, during which either side can end the contract
quote: Both parties may agree in writing to place the domestic worker under probation for a period not exceeding ninety (90) days

claim: Domestic workers may not be made to work more than 10 hours a day, with breaks and at least 8 hours' continuous rest
quote: A domestic worker cannot be worked for more than ten hours in a single day.

claim: One full paid day off a week of at least 24 hours
quote: The domestic worker is entitled to one full day of rest per week with full pay, and this rest period must not be less than twenty-four continuous hours.

claim: 30 days' leave after 2 years if renewed, and a return ticket home every 2 years
quote: Every two years of service with the employer, the domestic worker is entitled to a round-trip ticket to their home country

claim: Sick leave up to 30 days: 15 days full pay, rest half pay
quote: The first fifteen (15) days are with full pay.

claim: Employer bears recruitment, residence, work permit and transfer fees
quote: To bear the costs of recruiting the domestic worker, profession change fees, service transfer fees, residency fees, work permit fees and their renewal

claim: Employer may not keep the worker's passport, papers or belongings
quote: Not to retain the domestic worker’s passport, any of their personal documents, identification papers, or personal belongings.

claim: Employer must let the worker contact family, embassy and authorities
quote: To enable the domestic workers to communicate with their family, their country’s embassy, human resources companies, and the competent authorities.

claim: Employer must give suitable housing and food or a food allowance
quote: To provide suitable accommodation for the domestic worker or similar category within or outside the workplace, and to provide suitable food or a monetary allowance for it.

claim: Employer may not make the worker work for others or in another profession
quote: Not to permit or assign the domestic worker to work for others, work for their own benefit, work in a different profession than the one specified

claim: Deductions from wages cannot exceed a quarter of the wage
quote: the total deduction shall not exceed one-quarter of the wage

claim: End-of-service benefit: one month's wage for every four consecutive years
quote: End of Service Benefit is calculated as one month's salary for every four consecutive years spent with the employer.

claim: Employer must settle wages and rights within one week of the contract ending, two weeks if the worker ends it
quote: the employer must pay their wages and settle their rights within one week at most from the date the domestic work contract ends

claim: Termination without valid reason entitles the other side to two months' salary unless the contract says otherwise
quote: the other party is entitled to compensation equivalent to two months' salary

claim: The worker may end the contract keeping her rights if the employer breaches it, deceived her, abuses her, gives dangerous work or rents her out
quote: The domestic worker has the right to terminate the contract with the domestic employer while retaining their legal rights in any of the following cases:

claim: Claims must be brought within 12 months of the contract ending
quote: if more than twelve months have passed since the termination of the domestic employment contract

claim: A worker who returns without valid reason pays her own ticket
quote: The domestic worker shall bear the costs of their return to their home country if it is determined that they are unfit for work or if they wish to return without a valid reason.

claim: Worker who violates the regulation: fine up to SR 2,000 or ban on working in Saudi Arabia
quote: A fine not exceeding 2,000 riyals or a ban on working in the Kingdom, or both.

claim: The ministry receives domestic worker complaints and settles them amicably
quote: the Ministry shall have jurisdiction to receive complaints, settle them amicably, and record violations committed by the domestic employer or the domestic worker.

claim: Domestic work contract ends at 60 unless both agree
quote: The domestic worker reaches the age of sixty, unless both parties agree otherwise.

claim: 14 domestic professions including domestic worker, private driver, nanny, cook, house farmer
quote: 14 professions fall within the scope of domestic workers at present

claim: Recruitment offices may not take any commission or recruitment money from the worker
quote: The office shall not, by itself or a third party, request or accept from any domestic worker, whether before or after starting work, any commission in exchange for obtaining the work

claim: Recruitment offices must tell the worker the type of work and pay, and house workers until delivered to employers and if they leave
quote: Informing the worker of the type and nature of the work and the amount of pay.

claim: Recruitment offices must house and support domestic workers who are absent or refuse to work for the employer
quote: Providing appropriate housing and support for the domestic workers whose recruitment is mediated in the event of their absence or refusal to work for the employer.

claim: The ministry tries amicable settlement within 5 working days, then a committee decides in the same or a second session within 10 working days
quote: The Ministry may settle the case between the two parties amicably within five working days

claim: Employer must complete and pay for a driver's driving licence
quote: Completing the requirements for issuing a driving license for the driver’s profession, issuing and renewing the license, and paying the fees.

claim: Employer handles medical exam, issuing and renewing the iqama and paying fees after arrival
quote: Completing the medical examination procedures after the worker arrives in the Kingdom, issuing and renewing the residency and paying the fees.

claim: Expatriate working illegally for himself: SR 10,000 fine and deportation the first time, rising to SR 50,000 and 6 months' prison
quote: Penalty for a self-employed expatriate “illegal workers”.

claim: Ministry may transfer a domestic worker without the employer's approval: 3 wages unpaid, not collected within 15 days, no iqama issued or renewed within 30 days, rented out, dangerous tasks, ill-treatment, employer misses 2 committee sessions, termination in probation
quote: The Ministry may transfer the domestic worker services to another employer without the approval of the current one in the following cases:

claim: Grounds include unpaid wages for three consecutive or sporadic months
quote: Proving the employer has been not paying the worker’s wages for three consecutive or sporadic wages without reason regarding the worker.

claim: Grounds include not collecting the worker from the office or shelter within 15 days
quote: Not picking the domestic worker up from the intermediary recruitment office or shelter homes within (15) days

claim: Grounds include no iqama issued or renewed within 30 days
quote: The employer not obtaining a residence permit for the domestic worker, or not renewing it 30 days after obtaining or renewal expiration.

claim: Grounds include ill-treatment and the employer missing two dispute sessions
quote: Proving the ill-treatment towards the domestic worker by the employer or any of their family members.

claim: Employer can withdraw an absence report within 15 days; after that it is final
quote: The employer is allowed to withdraw the absence report within (15) days from submitting it, after which the report is considered final and cannot be withdrawn.

claim: After an absence report the worker has 60 days to transfer or request final exit, otherwise she violates residency rules
quote: In case the worker failed to submit a request to transfer services or a final exit visa, they are considered violating the residency system.

claim: Transfer or final exit within 60 days of the absence report
quote: within (60) days after submitting the report, with the worker’s status as absent from work
